Target company: Apple (AAPL). Apple develops and sells personal computing devices including iPhone, Mac and iPad, with operating systems and digital services.

Focal announcement: Apple expands tools to help businesses connect with customers.

Decision cutoff: 2024-10-16T23:59:59-04:00. Use only information available before this cutoff.

Source: Apple expands tools to help businesses connect with customers. Published date: 2024-10-16. URL: https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2024/10/apple-expands-tools-to-help-businesses-connect-with-customers.

Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: For the first time, businesses of all sizes around the world — even those without a brick-and-mortar presence — can manage the way they appear to over 1 billion Apple users using Apple Business Connect . “We’re excited to offer all businesses — including those without a physical location — the ability to create a brand that appears across the Apple apps that over a billion people use every day,” said David Dorn, Apple’s senior director of Internet Software and Services Product. “We designed Business Connect to empower businesses to present the best, most accurate information to Apple users. Since last year, businesses have been able to claim and manage their location place cards through Business Connect, including adding and updating photos and logos; inviting customers to take actions like ordering food or making a reservation directly from the place card; and presenting customers with special promotions. Businesses can sign up for Branded Mail today, and their logo will begin appearing to customers later this year.

Historical limitation: the exact historical article version is unverified; publication date does not establish that today's text existed then.

Pre-announcement expectations: No point-in-time analyst consensus or market-implied expectation is available.

Incremental financial magnitude inputs: not supplied.

Prediction target: buy at the first regular-session opening price after the cutoff; compare with the fifth regular-session closing price, counting entry as session one. Predict raw price return. Up means above +1.00%; flat means -1.00% through +1.00% inclusive; down means below -1.00%. The initial pre-entry price reaction is outside the target.

Do not infer analyst consensus, corporate cash spending, incremental sales, or a news-attributed price reaction when it is not supplied.
